<thought>We need a template that retrosynthetically disconnects an amide back to a carboxylic acid and an amine, i.e., it breaks a C‑O bond of an aliphatic carboxylic acid and forms a C‑N bond, yielding an amide. Using the available functional group names, the correct term for the broken group is “aliphatic carboxylic acid” and the formed group is “amide”. We'll search the template catalog with these criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
